reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the critic judged that the reading misread the request: The reading maps "the causes are fixed in Athena" to Restart.via. The code documents `--via` as "What the new context read to resume" (crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs:450), so that field does not record whether a cause was fixed. The other mappings hold: cost, minutes and tokens record the cost, and `lost` records what was lost. The fix part of the requirement has no matching field. (round 1 of 5). The plan's structure is sound. It reuses the O5-01 restart record, adds a separate `restart review` label and StatusView field that satisfy every_measure_label_names_a_status_view_field_and_a_printed_line (status.rs:1689-1708), and models its spec test on oly_b_o5_01 (status.rs:1660-1686). Its end-to-end demonstration goes through Manager::restart, Athena::status and display::status with the existing Fixture and Lines (common/mod.rs:308). StatusView has one constructor (status.rs:1285) and no Default, and no JSON snapshot reads "restarts", so the additive field is safe. The core of the mechanism is wrong, though. It counts `via` entries as "fixes in Athena", but `via` is documented as what the new context read to resume (main.rs:450), and the existing lifecycle test records `via: ["athena status"]`, which the review would count as a fix. The status line and the spec mechanism would therefore claim the causes are fixed when nothing records a fix. The planner should record fixes in their own field (an optional `fixed` with a serde default; criterion 5 already allows a new field) or stop claiming to show fixes. Athena's finding about the new test file is minor and acceptable. Findings: minor: crates/athena-cli/tests/status_restarts.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-cli/tests/status_restarts.rs); major: `via` records what the new context read to resume, not a fix in Athena, so the plan counts the wrong thing as "fixes in Athena" and will report false fixes. (Plan decision 2, step 2 (RestartReview fixes/no_fix/lost_no_fix), step 8 (mechanism text), demonstration 3); minor: Minutes and tokens are summed across estimated and measured quantities with no sign of which is which. (Step 2 / step 4 (minutes and tokens totals)); minor: If the fix moves to a new field, the dependents list must cover the record schema and the CLI argument. (Dependents)
